scope: Customer-facing Speed Quote review, linked customs checkout, booking completion and confirmed invoice PDF
changes: Label cost includes EasyInvio margin and carrier charges; wholesale and markup are excluded from both customer UI and public quote payloads
Fuel is split only when reported; otherwise included in label cost. Protection is Not added, without unsupported tax-exempt claims
Removed quote-review customs preview and JSON download actions
Book action opens a responsive customs choice and adjacent editable goods form, then explicit final-price confirmation
Fixed document-variable shadowing that stopped successful booking download controls from rendering
Server-owned stable EI invoice reference stored in automation_order and automation_customs, linked to the shipment and final PDF
Product, HS, value and address fields start empty with placeholders; product edits clear stale HS selections
Official UK tariff search is integrated in checkout and the standalone HS finder; no mock confidence percentages
OTHER export category requires a written reason; standard checkout explains recipient-paid duties under DAP
Actual shipping price is carried separately from customs goods values, including EasyPost-required USD goods values
Final EasyInvio commercial invoice PDF requires a confirmed label and CAPTURED reservation; tenant isolation enforced
Sendcloud pending acceptance holds credit; read-only durable polling finalizes once and preserves disabled-provider recovery
Invalid optional legacy webhook map fails closed rather than taking down the app; .env secrets were not changed

verification.browser: Customer checkout and existing admin/client responsive navigation passed; controlled API responses
verification.database: Actual Supabase sandbox rollback-only checkout probe passed; controlled carrier HTTP, zero real carrier purchases
verification.official_tariff: Genuine public API search for electric smoothing irons returned HS 851640 among candidates
verification.pdf: Sample PDF rendered and visually reviewed; brand, invoice reference, goods, freight, currencies, category and signature visible
verification.server: Configured backend running at http://127.0.0.1:8000/ with all four checkout endpoints registered

database_updates: No required migration for checkout. Invoice linkage uses existing shipment metadata. Optional migration 025 adds only the pending-label worker performance index; not applied remotely.
limits: A real external carrier must accept the lane, addresses, service and customs data; the controlled database probe is not a genuine international label-purchase pass
Tariff results are UK national entries with common six-digit HS prefixes; shipper review and destination requirements remain necessary
Ambiguous iron box requires clarification; no code is guessed
DDP and other Incoterms are not enabled in standard checkout without a verified carrier contract; no artificial insurance product or currency conversion is offered
Commercial invoices require shipper review and signature; carrier-issued CN22/CN23 forms are not replaced by a branded PDF
TRACKING_WEBHOOK_KEYS is currently malformed JSON. Legacy tracking stays disabled until corrected; native provider webhooks use encrypted database configuration
Sendcloud official export-reason enum does not include OTHER. Unsupported categories are rejected before purchase; supported reasons are mapped to its native schema.
